extras: Requires adding the token file to .gitignore.
intentEvidence: Browse your Codecks cards inside Obsidian and pull the ones you care about into Project Manager with Time Tracking as real projects and tasks
problem: Users must manually transfer or retype information from Codecks cards into Obsidian's project management system.

relations.evidence: Install Project Manager with Time Tracking — this plugin imports through its API and will say so if it is missing.

summary: Codecks Bridge allows users to browse cards from Codecks and import them into Project Manager as projects and tasks within Obsidian.
